defs.def: extremely attractive and impressive; deserving praise 壮丽的；宏伟的；值得赞扬的nounadv.

ex.s: When I was a little girl， my family moved to a tiny town at the bottom of a big mountain． One day after school， while exploring the green woods of this magnificent mountain， I almost fell on a set of stairs． What could these steps lead to？ Curiosity got the best of me as I knew it would be starting to get dark soon． I started climbing up those strangely mysterious steps．
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我家搬到了一座大山脚下的一个小镇。一天放学后，在探索这座雄伟山峦的翠绿树林时，我差点被一段台阶绊倒。这些台阶通向哪里呢？好奇心战胜了我，尽管我知道天很快就要黑了。我开始攀登那些神秘莫测的台阶。

ex.s: Han Gan and His Horses 1 What a magnificent horse!
ex.t: 韩幹与他的马：多么雄伟的一匹马！

ex.s: The Little Prince Once when I was six years old I saw a magnificent picture in a book, called True Stories from Nature, about the primeval forest.
ex.t: 我六岁时在一本名为《自然的真实故事》的书中 看到了一幅关于原始森林的壮观的画。

ex.s: That is why, at the age of six, I gave up what might have been a magnificent career as a painter.
ex.t: 这就是为什么，在六岁时，我放弃了 作为一名画家的伟大事业。

ex.s: The magnificent halls and walls proudly display the essence and culmination of traditional Chinese architecture.
ex.t: 宏伟的大厅和墙壁自豪地展示着传统中国建筑的精髓和巅峰。
